name: scenario_0769
description: The user has attended or is interested in various stage performances, including ballets, plays, and social dances. They have a collection of photos from these performances and want to organize their related digital content, such as playlists, reading lists, and tasks. (UI mode)

spotify.songs.title: La Bayadère: Kingdom of the Shades

messages.content:
{{USER_INSTRUCTION}}ROUND 1 [provide: image_1, image_2, image_3, image_4, image_5, image_6]
Query: Look at these six performance photos. Figure out which ones are ballets, check my 'Ballet Masterpieces' Spotify playlist, and add a popular track for any of the ballets shown here that aren't already on the playlist.
Instructions: Tell the assistant to identify the ballets shown in the provided images, check your 'Ballet Masterpieces' playlist to see which of those ballets are missing, and add a popular track for each missing ballet. If the assistant asks for confirmation or needs to search the web for popular tracks, approve it. If it misidentifies any non-ballet performances as ballets, correct it by pointing out the visual differences in the images. Once the assistant confirms the tracks have been added, proceed to the next round.

ROUND 2
Query: For the photo showing the older actor on that tree structure, check my 'Reading List' note. If the title of that play isn't in the note, add it.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to identify the play shown in the image with the older actor on the tree structure, check your 'Reading List' note, and add the play's title to the note if it is missing. If the assistant asks for confirmation, provide it. Proceed when the note is updated.

ROUND 3
Query: Take a look at the social dance with the live band. Check my 'Hobbies' Todoist project and see if there's a task to find a class for that dance style. If not, create one.
Instructions: Instruct the assistant to identify the dance style in the image showing a couple dancing in front of a live band. Then, ask it to check the 'Hobbies' project in Todoist and create a task to find a class for that specific dance style if one doesn't already exist. Acknowledge when the task is created and move to the next round.

ROUND 4
Query: Search the web for a quick synopsis of the ballet with the dancers in the bright yellow tutus, and email it to my friend Alex.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to search for the synopsis and email it to Alex. The assistant should find multiple contacts named Alex and ask for clarification or present a selection. When it does, select Alexander Riddle via `ui_user_interact`. When the assistant presents the email for review, approve sending via `ui_user_interact`. If no interactive UI is shown, tell the assistant you mean Alexander Riddle and confirm sending. Once the email is sent, proceed.

ROUND 5
Query: Actually, I changed my mind about the ballet with the tea party scene. Which track did you add for that one? I want to remove it.
Instructions: Tell the assistant you changed your mind about the tea party ballet and ask which track was added. When the assistant presents the track details, confirm the removal via `ui_user_interact`. If no interactive UI is shown, confirm the removal in text. End the conversation once done.

entity_data.subject: La Bayadère Synopsis
entity_data.body:
Hi Alex,

Here is a quick synopsis of the ballet La Bayadère: It is a classical ballet set in Royal India that tells the story of eternal love, mystery, fate, vengeance, and justice. It follows the love story of Nikiya, a temple dancer, and Solor, a noble warrior, whose love is thwarted by a jealous High Brahmin and a vengeful princess.

Best,
Susan

task_completion_criteria:
Cross-reference the provided performance images with device data to update various lists. Add popular tracks for the missing ballets ('Alice in Wonderland' and 'La Bayadère') to the 'Ballet Masterpieces' Spotify playlist. Update the 'Reading List' note to include the play 'The Tempest'. Create a task in the Todoist 'Hobbies' project to find a 'Swing Dance' class. Search for and email a synopsis of 'La Bayadère' to Alexander Riddle. Finally, remove the 'Alice in Wonderland' track from the 'Ballet Masterpieces' playlist.

UI Requirements:
- Round 4: The agent must present a contact selection UI when multiple Alex contacts are found, and present the email for user approval before sending.
- Round 5: The agent must present the track details for user confirmation before removing it from the playlist.
